rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable optimizations. concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) cancels superseded in-progress runs for the same workflow/branch. Swatinem/rust-cache (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is already present in test, miri, msrv, lockfile, docs, rustfmt, clippy, and coverage. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated: the ci aggregator requires every matrix outcome and fails on cancelled/skipped results, and fail-fast is already the GitHub Actions default (true), so making it explicit is a no-op that changes nothing. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is unsupported: the CI history contains only failures/cancellations with no successful-duration history, and bounding Rust jobs (especially Windows/macOS test builds) risks cutting valid slow runs. No schedule, Bazel build, or test-selection target exists. All required checks are preserved, so no supported change remains.
